summary: Added exploration bucket to costflow. In daemon.js: (1) tagged nodes with exploration:true when task.git.branch starts with 'orch/attempt/', (2) split flow.waste into wasteExploration and wasteTrapped post-computeFlow, (3) totals.exploration = exploration tokens, totals.trapped excludes exploration, (4) autonomy_score numerator now includes exploration tokens. In graph.html: added Exploration chip (amber #e3b341) between Productive and Infra that only renders when exploration > 0; also added exploration row to the Productive chip's breakdown tooltip.

subject: Costflow: add exploration bucket for fan-out branch attempt tokens
description: In daemon.js /costflow endpoint: tokens from tasks whose branch is orch/attempt/* should not land in trapped. Instead, attribute them to the parent problem task as a new exploration bucket. Winning branch tokens = productive. Losing branch tokens = exploration (valuable, not waste). Update the dashboard to show exploration separately from trapped and productive. This requires: (1) linking attempt tasks to their parent via the task key prefix convention, (2) new totals.exploration field in costflow response, (3) dashboard hero metric update.
